text: {"lessons":["My account has fallen from NT$104,474 to NT$91,915 despite no trades; holding through declines is still a consequential choice, so I should review my risk and allocation.","The month-to-month moves have varied, reinforcing that recent performance alone is not a reliable basis for predicting what comes next.","Because losses weigh heavily on me, I should make any changes deliberately and based on a clear portfolio reason—not simply react to the latest drop."]}
